instructions.text: Finder lists files, folders, apps, and devices. Read the current folder and selected item before acting; list view exposes useful details such as kind and modification date.
View > Show Preview displays information and a preview for the selected file. This can help distinguish similarly named files before opening one.
File > New Folder creates a folder. Enter its intended name and verify that it appears in the intended location.
A selected file is not necessarily open. Use the offered open or double-click action when the task requires its contents, then verify the expected app or document appears.

provenance.evidence: Project workflow guidance, not validated live in this app. Workflow guidance: distinguish selection from successful navigation using a fresh observation.

instructions.text: Finder selections represent files and folders. A paste into a Finder window may copy files rather than insert text; use the observed filename editor for renaming and a text app for writing prose.

provenance.evidence: Project workflow guidance, not validated live in this app. Flick clipboard actions must be chosen for the current control and clipboard content; proposed focus check.

instructions.text: Check both item name and containing location after a copy, move, or rename. If an operation reports an error, inspect the destination before retrying; an existing result may already satisfy the task.

provenance.evidence: Project workflow guidance, not validated live in this app. Proposed duplicate-avoidance and outcome check for file operations; no shell or filesystem shortcut required.
